$comment: [X2.3] Playwright MCP attach spec. Tier-1 first-party-ms. Shape === mcp-specs/_template.json (X2.1). Package is the REAL @playwright/mcp (NOT @microsoft/mcp-playwright). CC0-1.0.
title: Browser Automation
description: Cross-browser automation — navigate, click, type, screenshot, and inspect live pages via the official Playwright MCP server.

env_vars.name: PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH
env_vars.description: Optional override for the browser-binary install location. Defaults to the Playwright cache dir; set to pin browsers in a shared/CI cache.

auth.recipe: no credentials required; first run downloads browser binaries on demand.

sample_tools.name: browser_navigate
sample_tools.summary: Navigate the active page to a URL.

sample_tools.name: browser_click
sample_tools.summary: Click an element by accessible selector.

sample_tools.name: browser_type
sample_tools.summary: Type text into a focused input.

sample_tools.name: browser_snapshot
sample_tools.summary: Capture an accessibility snapshot of the page.

sample_tools.name: browser_take_screenshot
sample_tools.summary: Capture a screenshot of the page or element.

known_limitations: First use downloads browser binaries (Chromium/Firefox/WebKit) — the initial attach may be slow and requires network + disk.
Headless by default; some sites that block automated browsers may behave differently than a real user session.
Destructive-action audit (X2.18): no destructive tools — browser automation does not delete server-side resources.

client_install.claude_desktop: Add to claude_desktop_config.json mcpServers as `playwright`: { command: npx, args: [-y, @playwright/mcp] }.
client_install.vscode: Add to .vscode/mcp.json servers as `playwright` (VS Code Insider, MCP preview).
